title: Risk Radar canonical risk
description: One canonical risk with its source assessments. Enforced in CI by pipeline/analysis.py (validate). Unquantified evidence stays absent: never use 0 for 'not quantified'.

id.description: Stable canonical identifier; new assessments are added to an existing id.

summary.description: Neutral explanation in Risk Radar's words.

match.description: Keywords used to auto-match new signals (unreviewed).

coding.description: Risk Radar's own ordinal judgements (1 low, 2 medium, 3 high) for the experimental ranking; preparedness = preparedness gap. Not source-reported.

date.description: Publication date, YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD (no invented precision).

via.description: Secondary report used to verify, when the primary page was not checked.

method.description: observation, modelling, expert judgement, perception survey, scenario analysis, qualitative

rating.description: Source's own rating, verbatim or closely paraphrased, with its native scale.

independence.description: Assessments sharing the same underlying data or publication share a group, to avoid double counting.
